notes: The idiom גָּלָה אֹזֶן is fused to the single word *disclose*; the *to* and *unto* are supplied by the construction and the verb's valency and do not defeat rule 30's one-rendering condition.
Every supplied *it* in the verse answers to no object morpheme and is `added` at each occurrence; the apodosis *then* is `added` because that apodosis writes no conjunction at all.
Variant WLC.RUT.4.4.v001 is underdetermined with a compatible base fallback, so no rule 53 case arises; the versional note on s024 was read and set aside under rule 38.
